name: PropheSea
tagline: A swipeable card feed of data-backed prediction-market trades matched to your interests.

awards: Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty

problem: Prediction markets overwhelm newcomers with options and information.
solution: Personalised, data-backed trade suggestions in a swipeable card interface.
demo_moment: Team-described: swipe through trade cards and bet on one.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Familiar interaction patterns lower the entry barrier for complex markets.
